Short answer

To install chromium on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add chromium. It is a 181.7 MB download (435.3 MB installed), version 158.0.8127.88-2, licensed BSD-3-Clause. A web browser built for speed, simplicity, and security. Check the project site for current pricing.

Install chromium on Omarchy

A web browser built for speed, simplicity, and security

The official repository lists this package in Utilities. It was added on 2026-11-24.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add chromium
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 158.0.8127.88-2:
    pacman -Qi chromium

Open and use chromium

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

pacman -Ql chromium

Frequently asked questions

How do I install chromium on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add chromium. The download is 181.7 MB and it takes 435.3 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is chromium free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed BSD-3-Clause.

How do I uninstall chromium?

Run omarchy pkg drop chromium. It removes the package from your system.

What does chromium depend on?

The package declares 27 dependencies: alsa-lib, at-spi2-core, cairo, dbus, expat, glib2, glibc, gtk3, hicolor-icon-theme, libcups, libgcc, libpulse and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is chromium in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as chromium (version 158.0.8127.88-2) in the official Omarchy package repository. Project site: https://www.chromium.org/Home.
